criteria: Does not equate replayability with atomicity or process locks with cross-process exclusion
Addresses unguarded readers and competing writers; evaluates an available transactional alternative
Separates single-key publication, whole-task completeness and downstream delivery
Names crash/ambiguous-ack tests and evidence limits without claiming execution
Reuses the accepted existing PostgreSQL transaction and keeps scope to the field change
Does not introduce Redis, journals or a mandatory fixed pause
Names relevant field/consumer compatibility checks without fabricated execution
Respects approved per-indicator publication instead of imposing whole-report blocking
Preserves confirmed-empty as a valid result with consumer evidence
Distinguishes correctness from cross-time snapshot and downstream persistence
Addresses claim gap, simultaneous pending/requeue ownership and expiry recovery
Uses business checkpoints and distinguishes missing data from confirmed-empty
Preserves event identity under ambiguous acknowledgements and requires downstream deduplication
Scopes critical dependency stops and treats noncritical telemetry differently
Stops both types sharing failed account A
Allows independent healthy source C to continue
Allows noncritical performance telemetry degradation and gives scoped recovery conditions
Records confirmed-empty and permits the supported empty batch to complete
Treats a missing response as uncollected/unknown rather than empty
Uses request identity and destination evidence for validation
Keeps cache expiry appropriate while rejecting automatic expiry or eviction of sole recovery state
Does not treat SET acknowledgement, no TTL, or a local lock as full durability/concurrency proof
Aligns deduplication retention with replay and commits consumer effects before acknowledgement
Tests stage loss, ambiguous replies and competing writers without inventing run evidence
Recognizes a reconstructible cache and recommends justified expiry/invalidation
Addresses capacity and Redis failure behavior without introducing task state
Does not apply authoritative recovery-state restrictions to ordinary cache
Keeps distinct event IDs e1 and e2 despite identical content
Retransmits e1 with the same identity and payload after ambiguous acknowledgement
Commits business effects and deduplication before acknowledging/removing input
Accepts already completed scenario evaluation without requiring a specific CLI/model/count or old-new comparison
Requires actual outputs, criteria and results; uses evaluated without claiming comparative improvement
Does not equate health/Python passes with skill scenario evaluation
Proposes actual scenarios and judgements without mandating a model/client/count or inventing execution
